stories.title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Sparks Debate Over Self-Custody Security
stories.summary: An exploit affecting Coldcard hardware wallets has been disclosed, and CoinDesk reports analysts think the incident could push more investors toward regulated bitcoin products rather than self-custody. Cointelegraph separately examined whether the attack means hardware wallets as a category are now insecure.
stories.whyItMatters: Security incidents in self-custody tools can shift investor preference toward custodial, regulated products, with knock-on effects for how much trust the industry places in hardware wallets.
whatToWatch: Any patch or official response from Coldcard
Whether other hardware wallet makers report similar vulnerabilities
Whether ETF or custodial-product flows tick up in response
questions: What exactly is the vulnerability, and has it been fixed?
Is the risk specific to Coldcard or a broader class of hardware wallets?

sources.title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
Do the Coldcard attacks mean all hardware wallets are now insecure?

stories.title: Bitcoin Lags Record-Setting Equities Rally as a Corporate Holder Cashes Out
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports bitcoin and the broader crypto market failed to keep pace as global equities markets hit record highs. Separately, CryptoSlate reported a cellular chipmaker sold 1,200 bitcoin from its treasury, using the proceeds to erase its debt entirely and double its cash position.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's underperformance against a booming equities market, alongside a corporate holder liquidating its treasury position, raises questions about near-term demand and how corporate BTC holders are managing balance-sheet risk.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin's relative underperformance versus equities persists
Whether other corporate treasuries follow with similar sales
questions: Which chipmaker sold the bitcoin, and when did the sale occur?
Is this an isolated treasury decision or part of a broader trend among corporate holders?

sources.title: How dumping 1,200 Bitcoin helped a cellular chipmaker completely erase its debt and double its cash

stories.title: All Six US Solana ETFs Log Zero Net Flows for a Fifth Straight Day
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that all six US-listed Solana ETFs recorded absolute zero net flows for five consecutive trading days.
stories.whyItMatters: Flat flows across an entire product category suggest fading or stalled investor interest, a useful signal for gauging demand for altcoin ETFs beyond bitcoin and ether.
whatToWatch: Whether flows resume in either direction in coming sessions
Any commentary from issuers on the flow drought
questions: What's behind the stagnation — thin investor awareness, risk-off sentiment, or something specific to these products?

stories.title: BlackRock's ETHA Reverse Split Set to Cut Ethereum Trading Costs Sharply
stories.summary: BlackRock is carrying out a rare reverse split of its ETHA ether ETF, which CryptoSlate says will make gaining ether exposure through the fund roughly 70 times cheaper than trading it directly on Coinbase.
stories.whyItMatters: A reverse split reshapes the price and liquidity profile of one of the largest ether ETFs, potentially redirecting where investors go to get ether exposure.
whatToWatch: The effective date of the reverse split
How trading volume and bid-ask spreads shift once it takes effect
questions: What's driving the reverse split now, and does it change ETHA's fees or underlying holdings?

sources.title: BlackRock’s rare ETHA reverse split is about to make trading Ethereum 70 times cheaper than Coinbase

stories.title: CryptoQuant: Whale Accumulation Suggests Bear Market Nearing 'Late Stage'
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that on-chain analytics firm CryptoQuant says large bitcoin holders have been accumulating, which the firm frames as a sign the current bear market is entering its late stage.
stories.whyItMatters: Whale accumulation is a closely watched on-chain signal, but calls about bear-market timing are inherently speculative and worth treating with caution rather than as a trading signal.
whatToWatch: Whether accumulation trends continue in subsequent CryptoQuant reports
How price action develops relative to the claim
questions: What specific on-chain metrics underlie this 'late stage' assessment?
How accurate have similar CryptoQuant bear-market calls been historically?

stories.title: Russia Passes Law to Regulate Crypto Exchanges, Keeps Payment Ban in Place
stories.summary: Russia has passed legislation creating a regulatory framework for crypto exchanges, according to Bitcoin Magazine, while leaving its existing ban on using crypto for payments intact.
stories.whyItMatters: The law shows Russia tolerating regulated trading and investment activity while continuing to restrict crypto's everyday commercial use, relevant to global regulatory divergence and sanctions-related scrutiny.
whatToWatch: Implementation and licensing details for exchanges under the new law
Whether any carve-outs for cross-border payments emerge
questions: Which exchanges will qualify for licensing?
How strictly will the payment ban continue to be enforced?

stories.title: RedotPay Vows to 'Vigorously' Fight Binance Lawsuit
stories.summary: Crypto payments firm RedotPay said it will defend itself vigorously against a lawsuit filed by Binance, according to CoinDesk.
stories.whyItMatters: Legal disputes between major crypto platforms can point to deeper business or compliance conflicts and carry contagion risk for partners and users of either firm.
whatToWatch: Court filings detailing the specifics of Binance's claims
RedotPay's formal legal response
questions: What exactly is Binance alleging, and what's financially or operationally at stake?

stories.title: White House Reviewing Crypto Clarity Act Ethics Text Ahead of August Deadline
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine reports the White House is now reviewing ethics-related text within the Crypto Clarity Act as an August deadline approaches.
stories.whyItMatters: The Crypto Clarity Act is a significant pending piece of market-structure legislation, and ethics-text review at this stage could affect its timing or final provisions.
whatToWatch: Whether the White House completes its review before the August deadline
Any resulting changes to the bill's language
questions: What specific ethics provisions are under review?
Could this review delay the broader bill's progress?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Inflows Even as Cold Wallet Hack Reignites Custody Debate

stories.whyItMatters: Continued ETF inflows despite a custody-related security incident suggest investors may be leaning further toward regulated custodial products over self-custody solutions.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows persist in coming sessions
Further details on the cold wallet hack and any industry response
questions: How large were the inflows relative to recent trends?
Will the custody debate meaningfully shift assets from self-custody toward ETFs?
